patterns: I want to track my package
responses: You can track your order from the 'My Orders' section using your order ID. Orders usually arrive within 3-5 working days.

patterns: I want to cancel my order
How do I cancel an order
responses: You can cancel your order from the 'My Orders' section before it is shipped. Once shipped, please contact support.

patterns: How do I get a refund
How can I return an item
When will I get my refund
responses: You can request a return or refund within 7 days of delivery. Refunds are processed within 5-7 working days.

patterns: What payment options do you have
Do you have cash on delivery
My payment is not going through
responses: We accept credit/debit cards, UPI, net banking and cash on delivery. If your payment failed, please try again or use another method.

patterns: Do you deliver to my city
responses: Delivery takes 3-5 working days. Shipping is free on orders above Rs. 500.

patterns: How do I change my password
Unable to log in to my account
How do I create an account
responses: Use the 'Forgot Password' option on the login page to reset your password. You can manage your details in 'My Account'.

patterns: I want to speak to an agent
responses: You can reach our support team at support@example.com or call 1800-123-456 between 9 AM and 6 PM.

patterns: I am not satisfied with the service
responses: We are sorry for the inconvenience. Please share your order ID and we will resolve the issue as soon as possible.
